name: ModalBody

props.name: hasForm
props.description: Provide whether the modal content has a form element. If `true` is used here, non-form child content should have `cds--modal-content__regular-content` class.

props.name: hasScrollingContent
props.description: Specify whether the modal contains scrolling content

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ModalBody rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
